name: Jinyu Bio-technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Jinyu Bio-technology Co., Ltd. engages in the research and development, production, and sale of veterinary biological products in China and internationally. The company's products focus on preventing porcine mycoplasmal pneumonia, pseudorabies, highly pathogenic avian influenza, brucellosis, and other Class I, II, and III animal diseases.
